root_cause.text: The IPv4 subsystem failed to restrict the configuration of Source and Record Route (SRR) IP options to privileged users, allowing unprivileged applications to manipulate packet routing.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a capability check (`!ns_capable(net->user_ns, CAP_NET_RAW)`) in `ip_options_get` when `opt->opt.srr` is set, returning `-EPERM` for unauthorized users.

intent_record.intent_summary: Enforce CAP_NET_RAW capability checks for IP source routing options to restrict unauthorized usage.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check in ip_options_get to verify if the user has CAP_NET_RAW capability when Source Routing (srr) is requested, freeing the options structure and returning -EPERM if unauthorized.
intent_record.how: Restricts the use of IP Source Routing to privileged users with CAP_NET_RAW in the target network namespace, preventing unprivileged source routing configuration.
